description: Determination as to whether prior approval is required for change of use from office use (Class E) to use as a two bedroom residential unit (Class C3).
application_type_full: Prior Approval: Change of use from Commercial, Business and Service (Use Class E) to Dwellinghouses (Use Class C3)
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - This notice indicates that the proposed development would comply with conditions MA.2 of Schedule 2 Part 3 Class M of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (as amended) ("the GPDO"). 
It is a requirement of condition MA.2(5) of the GPDO that the development must be completed within a period of 3 years starting with the prior approval date. 
It is a requirement of condition M.A2(6) of the GPDO that any building permitted to be used as a dwellinghouse by virtue of Class MA is to remain in use as a dwellinghouse within the meaning of Class C3 of Schedule 1 to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the use as a dwellinghouse.
It is a requirement of paragraph W(12) of the GPDO that the development is carried out in accordance with the details provided in the application unless the developer and the local planning authority agree in writing.

Condition : 2 - Prior to occupation, details of proposed parking for the unit hereby approved shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The allocated parking shall be retained for parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose. 
Reason: To ensure adequate arrangements are made for off-street parking in accordance with Council policies LP2 and LP51 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 3 - Prior to occupation, details of the siting, design and materials of refuse and recycling storage to serve the development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The refuse storage facilities shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to occupation of the development, and shall be retained thereafter.
Reason: In the interests of amenity and hygiene, in accordance with Council policy LP1 and LP2 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.

Condition : 4 - Prior to occupation, details of the location, number and design of secure and covered cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  The cycle parking shall be provided in accordance with the approved details prior to the occupation of the development and be retained for cycle parking purposes for the users of the development and for no other purpose.
Reason: To ensure adequate provision is made for cycle parking in accordance with Council policies LP2, LP37, LP51, PM2, PM3, PM4, PM6, PM7, PM8 and PM9 of the Local Plan coupled with the requirements of the National Planning Policy Framework.
